decision_payload.reasoning: Strong downward momentum (consecutive accelerating price drops) conflicts with current long position
decision_payload.analysis:
As an aggressive momentum trader, I focus on price momentum first. Recent prices show a **strong downward trend**: from ~283 → ~276 → ~211 (accelerating drops, 23.6% return negative). My current long position (198.9 shares) is against this momentum. 

Key rules: Ride strong trends, exit positions conflicting with momentum. Since the trend is sharply down, I need to reduce my long exposure to align with the downward momentum. Aggressive position sizing (up to 60 shares) applies here—selling 60 long shares will cut my long position and move closer to aligning with the bearish trend.
